main_text.l: KING OF GREAT BRITAIN, FRANCE, AND IRELAND,
We find it recorded for the
everlasting honour of Theodosius the younger,
that it was his use toa reason with his bishops
of the things contained in the holy Scriptures,
as if he himself had been one of their order:
and of the emperor Alexius in latter days, that
whatsoeverb time he could spare from the public
cares of the commonwealth, he did wholly
employ in the diligent reading of God's book,
and in conferring thereof with worthy men, of
whom his court was never empty. How little
{b} Euthym. Zigaben. in Præfat. Dogmatica Panoplia.

page.notes: The superscript letters a and b in the text are reference marks for the two footnotes. Show-through from the reverse page is not transcribed. The paragraph runs on past the visible end of the scan.
